title: Ecosystem map
blurb: Glossary, mind map, sister technologies, integration maps, bridges, and future hooks.

lessons.title: Glossary words from the connectivity page
lessons.summary: On an inbound call the A leg is the contact side and the B leg is the agent side. A transfer adds a second B leg. Cluster examples on the page are C14, E39, and M33.
objectives: Define A leg and B leg

p: The connectivity page says the A leg is the portion between the contact and NiCE CXone. On an inbound call that leg is ingress. The B leg, or agent leg, is the portion between NiCE CXone and the agent, and it is egress. The legs meet on a media server.

On an outbound call both legs are egress, because both start in CXone. A transfer adds a second B leg. For an inbound transfer that is one ingress leg and two egress legs. The page says an outbound transfer is three egress legs.

NiCE CXone runs in AWS data centers. A cluster is a group of servers. The page's examples of cluster names are C14, E39, and M33. Those are examples, not a list of every cluster and not your tenant's name.

PSTN, on this page, is phone traffic routed by DID or toll-free number. The glossary in Contact Path only keeps a term when a page supports it. A word with no opened page does not get a definition here.

lessons.title: The mind map is a picture
lessons.summary: The ecosystem drawing puts the ACD in the middle. An arrow is only as strong as the lesson that cites it. The picture is not a network diagram and not a SIP trace.

p: Contact Path draws a mind map with the ACD in the middle and neighboring products around it. The connectivity page is the source for how a contact reaches CXone and then an agent. The drawing adds boxes so a person can remember the neighborhood.

A box without a lesson is decoration. This chapter's later lessons cite WFM bridges, Integration Hub, quality, analytics, and the Agentic Engagement Plane. Those citations are the edges. The picture does not add a protocol.
Write the product name, the page, and what actually moves: a call leg, a schedule, a recording, a ticket, or a REST call. If the page was not opened, the box says confirm and has no URL.
UCCE can appear on a WFM page and on a recording page for different reasons. This lesson does not collapse those reasons into one arrow.

lessons.title: Sister technologies this chapter opened
lessons.summary: The sisters in this chapter are the products whose pages were opened for it: WFM, QM, Interaction Analytics, Integration Hub, UCaaS, Salesforce CTI, and the Agentic Engagement Plane.
objectives: Match each sister to one page
Leave unopened products off the list

p: CXone WFM, on the pages this chapter uses, forecasts and schedules, then compares the schedule with ACD events. Quality Management builds forms and plans. Interaction Analytics groups transcripts into categories and can export JSON. Integration Hub stores REST connections for Studio.
Those four jobs are not interchangeable. A category is not a skill. A form is not a schedule. A REST connection is not an ACD.

UCaaS (1CX) is internal communications integrated with CXone. Salesforce CTI, on the install page, is Agent Workspace inside Lightning. The Agentic Engagement Plane is an orchestration layer above the CCaaS.
A product that was not opened is not added to this sister list to make the row symmetrical.

lessons.title: Two integration maps
lessons.summary: WFM has three methods and one ACD at a time. Integration Hub has REST templates. They are different maps. Historical WFM data is in 15-minute intervals. Real-time agent states are 3 seconds or longer. True to Interval is not supported.
objectives: Not treat Hub as a cutover

p: The third-party ACD page says CXone WFM supports three methods. Engagement Hub names Avaya CMS and Amazon Connect. The SDK names Smart Reach and is a Java toolkit. Point-to-point names Cisco UCCE, Cisco UCCX, and Avaya CMS_Legacy, and those require Advanced Services.

Only one ACD is integrated at a time. A third-party ACD and the CXone ACD are not integrated together. Historical data is in 15-minute intervals. Real-time agent states of 3 seconds or more are supported. The When Contact Ended paradigm is supported. The True to Interval paradigm is not.

Integration Hub is a different picture: one REST connection, reused from Studio, for the templates the hub page names. It does not say it replaces a WFM connector, and it does not list the ACD names from the WFM page.
Use the WFM page when the question is forecast data from another ACD. Use the hub page when the question is an API call from a script.

lessons.title: Bridges are the named rows
lessons.summary: A bridge in this lab is a row on a page that was opened. The WFM page names its ACDs and refuses a second ACD. Genesys, Five9, and Webex Contact Center are not on that list.
objectives: Copy a row only when it exists

p: From the third-party ACD page: Engagement Hub for Avaya CMS and Amazon Connect. SDK for Smart Reach. Point-to-point for Cisco UCCE, Cisco UCCX, and Avaya CMS_Legacy. Point-to-point requires Advanced Services for development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

The page also says it is written so internal teams and sales representatives can explain the options. It is not a self-serve cutover. This lesson does not add versions. The page that was opened does not print a version number.

Genesys does not appear on that WFM list. Five9 does not appear. Webex Contact Center does not appear. This chapter does not borrow a version or a connector for them. Five9 and Webex Contact Center are confirm.
A recording integration, a CTI frame, and a WFM connector can all be true for different products and still be different rows. Do not let one opened page stand in for the others.

lessons.title: Future hooks are labeled
lessons.summary: A future hook with an opened page is quoted and stopped where the page stops. A future hook with no page is confirm. AEP is the first kind. CPaaS is the second.

p: The Agentic Engagement Plane page was opened. It is an orchestration layer above your CCaaS. The pillars are Any Channel, Any AI Agent, and Any Human Agent. The channel and the conversation thread stay fixed when the handler changes. Failover can go to another bot, to the same AI agent in another region, or to a human. A human can take the interaction, assist while the AI stays customer-facing, or step in mid-flight.
The page does not give the admin clicks. This lab does not add them. AEP does not replace the skill, the schedule, or the evaluation form.
CPaaS has no opened page in this chapter. Five9 and Webex Contact Center have no opened connector page in this chapter. Each of those lines says confirm and shows no URL.

The ecosystem screen in Contact Path keeps the glossary, the mind map, the sister list, the integration maps, the bridges, and these hooks in separate sections so a confirm line cannot be mistaken for a citation.
